name: qbr-renewal
description: Generate an owned-products QBR through the website, deliver Google Slides, and prepare a source-backed renewal brief.

interface.shortDescription: Customer QBRs and clear renewal preparation
interface.longDescription: One plugin takes you from the QBR Express website to a verified native Google Slides deck and a concise CSM brief: value already realised, YoY and peer context, focus areas, product-linked next value moves, and discovery questions. Includes the qbr-express browser workflow, value-conversation evidence review, Scaled CS recommendations, and selective release checks. No QBR MCP, bridge or Local Delivery plugin is required. Google Drive and Z2 support retrieval and research.
defaultPrompt: Create a QBR for this customer using owned products only.
Prepare a QBR and one-page brief for this customer's renewal.
Prepare a renewal brief from this QBR without another deck.
